# gws recipe: Create a Meet space

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the create-meet-space recipe: the full « create a meeting and send the link » flow — create a Meet space with open access config, copy the meeting URI from the response, email the join link with `gws gmail +send`. A recipe, not a reference: distinct from `googleworkspace-cli-gws-meet` (the raw Meet API reference, lot 33) and from `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-review-meet-participants` in this lot (post-meeting attendance audit) — this one is creation plus distribution across two services. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the `gws-gmail` prerequisite comes from the same repo but is not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
